youtube_description:
In this adventure Redbeard camps in southern Oregon at Charles V. Stanton County Park and Campground.

On my way back from Mt Shasta I stop along the way to get some rest. This is a nice little campground on I-5 Exit 98. There are a couple of memorials, an area for the kids to play and access to the South Umpqua River. Be advised they only take cash.
youtube_title: Moto Camping at Stanton County Park
